topic.title: Gaussian-Process Regression and Learned Function Priors
topic.area: Continuous Models and Scientific Machine Learning
topic.overview: Gaussian processes model uncertainty over functions through a mean and covariance structure. This topic studies regression with input-dependent noise, additive and parametric approximations, robust inference, and data-driven priors. It also examines alternative learning objectives that optimize generalization guarantees rather than marginal likelihood alone.
topic.whyItMatters: A kernel encodes substantial assumptions about how outputs vary together. Useful uncertainty requires those assumptions and the noise model to fit the task, while scalable approximations must preserve the information needed for prediction.
topic.evolution: The collection begins with foundational GP regression and heteroscedastic models in the 1990s. Later work adds approximations, additive structure, and PAC-Bayesian learning. Recent empirical-prior methods estimate covariance from historical datasets with heterogeneous observation locations, expanding the role of data in defining the function-space prior itself.
openQuestions: When do learned priors transfer across datasets without becoming overconfident?
How can users compare uncertainty from different kernel and approximation choices?

papers.tldr: Intrinsic and extrinsic Matérn Gaussian processes have matching contraction rates under appropriate smoothness matching, despite possible practical advantages for intrinsic models.

papers.title: Sharp Calibrated Gaussian Processes
papers.tldr: A flexible Gaussian-process calibration method learns predictive quantiles that satisfy calibration constraints while improving sharpness.

papers.title: Energy-Efficient Gaussian Processes Using Low-Precision Arithmetic
papers.tldr: Low-precision arithmetic can substantially reduce Gaussian process regression energy use when the kernel matrix is well-conditioned.

papers.title: Robust and Conjugate Gaussian Process Regression
papers.tldr: RCGP uses generalized Bayesian inference to provide provable robustness while preserving standard Gaussian processes’ closed-form updates at virtually no extra cost.

papers.title: Stationarity without mean reversion in improper Gaussian processes
papers.tldr: Improper infinite-variance Gaussian process priors enable stationary, non-mean-reverting models with analytically computable posteriors.

papers.title: Linear Regression using Heterogeneous Data Batches
papers.tldr: A gradient-based algorithm learns subgroup regression rules from small heterogeneous batches under broader distributional conditions and reduced data requirements.

papers.title: Robust Gaussian Processes via Relevance Pursuit
papers.tldr: Relevance pursuit gives Gaussian processes point-specific noise levels for sparse-outlier robustness, with approximation guarantees derived from the optimization structure.

papers.title: The Price of Linear Time: Error Analysis of Structured Kernel Interpolation
papers.tldr: SKI error bounds reveal dimension-dependent conditions for combining controlled approximation error with linear-time Gaussian process inference.

papers.title: Gaussian Processes for Shuffled Regression
papers.tldr: GPSR learns flexible regression functions and prediction uncertainty when the pairing between inputs and outputs is unknown.

papers.title: Max Entropy Moment Kalman Filter for Polynomial Systems with Arbitrary Noise
papers.tldr: MEM-KF propagates moments and reconstructs maximum-entropy beliefs to filter polynomial systems with complex, non-Gaussian uncertainty.

papers.title: Optimal kernel regression bounds under energy-bounded noise
papers.tldr: The paper derives tight finite-data kernel regression uncertainty bounds under norm-bounded function and noise assumptions, including correlated noise.

papers.title: Robust and Computation-Aware Gaussian Processes
papers.tldr: RCaGP jointly accounts for outliers and computational approximation uncertainty to improve Gaussian-process reliability and benchmark performance.

papers.title: Stochastic Process Learning via Operator Flow Matching
papers.tldr: Operator flow matching learns distributions over functions and supports probability-density and regression estimates at arbitrary collections of points.

papers.title: AI4SLT: Empirical Processes in Lean 4 for Formal Statistical Learning Theory
papers.tldr: AI4SLT formalizes core empirical-process results and regression theory in Lean 4 through a human–AI proof-building workflow.

papers.title: Empirical Gaussian Processes
papers.tldr: Empirical Gaussian Processes learn their mean and covariance from historical datasets, reducing reliance on handcrafted kernels.
